34671-camps-and-trails.description: A book by Henry Abbott. without a single flap silently skated across the air to another tree on my right but a little nearer, where he could "view the subject from another standpoint." It now occurred to me, that, possibly the jay bird might also be needing some lunch so I tossed a small piece of bread out on the other end of the log when he slid down and ate it.

arxiv-1702-07922.title: The Hardness of Solving Simple Word Equations
arxiv-1702-07922.creator: Joel D. Day, Florin Manea, Dirk Nowotka
arxiv-1702-07922.description: Abstract We investigate the class of regular-ordered word equations. In such equations, each variable occurs at most once in each side and the order of the variables occurring in both sides is the preserved (the variables can be, however, separated by potentially distinct constant factors).

arxiv-2101-09102.title: Quantum lock-in detection of a vector light shift
arxiv-2101-09102.creator: Kosuke Shibata, Naota Sekiguchi, Takuya Hirano
arxiv-2101-09102.description: Abstract We demonstrate detection of a vector light shift (VLS) using the quantum lock-in method. The method offers precise and accurate VLS measurement without being affected by real magnetic field fluctuations. We detect a VLS on a Bose–Einstein condensate (BEC) of 87 Rb atoms caused by an optical trap beam with a resolution less than 1 Hz.

arxiv-2107-00666.title: Discovering Dark Matter at the LHC through Its Nuclear Scattering in Far-Forward Emulsion and Liquid Argon Detectors Preprint: PITT-PACC-2113
arxiv-2107-00666.creator: Brian Batell, Jonathan L. Feng, Ahmed Ismail, Felix Kling, Roshan Mammen Abraham, Sebastian Trojanowski
arxiv-2107-00666.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Brian Batell, Jonathan L. Feng, Ahmed Ismail, Felix Kling, Roshan Mammen Abraham, Sebastian Trojanowski. The LHC may produce light, weakly-interacting particles that decay to dark matter, creating an intense and highly collimated beam of dark matter particles in the far-forward direction. We investigate the prospects for detecting this dark matter in two far-forward detectors proposed for a future Forward Physics Facility: FASER ν \nu 2, a 10-tonne emulsion detector, and FLArE, a 10- to 100-tonne LArTPC.

arxiv-2109-07917.title: Modularity and effective Mordell I.
arxiv-2109-07917.creator: Levent Alpöge
arxiv-2109-07917.description: Abstract . We give an effective proof of Faltings’ theorem for curves mapping to Hilbert modular stacks over odd-degree totally real fields. We do this by giving an effective proof of the Shafarevich conjecture for abelian varieties of GL 2 \mathrm{GL}_{2} -type over an odd-degree totally real field.

arxiv-2211-13703.title: Multitask Learning for Low Resource Spoken Language Understanding
arxiv-2211-13703.creator: Quentin Meeus, Marie-Francine Moens, Hugo Van hamme
arxiv-2211-13703.description: Abstract We explore the benefits that multitask learning offer to speech processing as we train models on dual objectives with automatic speech recognition and intent classification or sentiment classification. Our models, although being of modest size, show improvements over models trained end-to-end on intent classification.

arxiv-2303-13699.title: Minuscule corrections to near-surface solar internal rotation using mode-coupling Journal: ApJS
arxiv-2303-13699.creator: ∗ Srijan Bharati Das, ∗ Samarth G. Kashyap, Deniz Oktay, Shravan M. Hanasoge, Jeroen Tromp
arxiv-2303-13699.description: Abstract The observed solar oscillation spectrum is influenced by internal perturbations such as flows and structural asphericities. These features induce splitting of characteristic frequencies and distort the resonant-mode eigenfunctions. Global axisymmertric flow — differential rotation — is a very prominent perturbation.

arxiv-2310-15262.title: Data Augmentation Techniques for Machine Translation of Code-Switched Texts: A Comparative Study
arxiv-2310-15262.creator: Injy Hamed, Nizar Habash, Ngoc Thang Vu
arxiv-2310-15262.description: Abstract Code-switching (CSW) text generation has been receiving increasing attention as a solution to address data scarcity. In light of this growing interest, we need more comprehensive studies comparing different augmentation approaches. In this work, we compare three popular approaches: lexical replacements, linguistic theories, and back-translation (BT), in the context of Egyptian Arabic-English CSW.

arxiv-2312-03872.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Author Name(s). This document serves as an overview of the different mechanisms and areas of governance in the BigCode project. arxiv-2511-04124.title: Decomposable Neuro Symbolic Regression
arxiv-2511-04124.creator: Giorgio Morales giorgiomorales@ieee.org, John W. Sheppard john.sheppard@montana.edu
arxiv-2511-04124.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Giorgio Morales giorgiomorales@ieee.org, John W. Sheppard john.sheppard@montana.edu. Symbolic regression (SR) models complex systems by discovering mathematical expressions that capture underlying relationships in observed data. However, most SR methods prioritize minimizing prediction error over identifying the governing equations, often producing overly complex or inaccurate expressions. To address this, we present a decomposable SR method that generates interpretable multivariate expressions leveraging transformer models, genetic algorithms (GAs), and genetic programming (GP).

Chain-of-Thought (CoT) has substantially empowered Large Language Models (LLMs) to tackle complex reasoning tasks, yet the verbose nature of explicit reasoning steps incurs prohibitive inference latency and computational costs, limiting real-world deployment.
